The hotel is not located at a great place.

The room was not clean, and looked old.

The staff did not even provide the key for the room. Throughout my stay, the door was kept unlocked.

There were a lot of mosquitoes, and the geyser was not plugged in.

I had booked for 3 days, and on the 2nd day, when I came back to the room at night, there was another couple staying there, and I had to shift to another room.

On contacting the hotel before arrival, I was told not to pay online, and to pay at the hotel. So, I paid only at the hotel.

But after a day, I got a message from Oyo that as I had not arrived, my booking had been cancelled!

Overall, not recommended.
